transfer.reference_limitation: Both DOP853 solves tighten tolerance but hold max_step=horizon/8; identical capped trajectories explain zero measured difference and do not establish actual temporal refinement. Require smaller max_step and roundoff floor before interpreting near-roundoff improvements.
transfer.C4_filter_limitation: Applying fixed fractional filter F to Richardson delta restores a leading (I-F)*local-error term. A smooth second-order base has local h^3 error; fixed F generally prevents full Richardson cancellation. Need measured orders and an h-dependent filter or certified correction decision; no order theorem established by this run.
